text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has proven her unmatched might!
First place goes to Vodka—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: A-Awesome! That three-way showdown was so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I came today! I feel like I just saw something incredible...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...! I won!
I won, I won, I won, I won!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I wooooon!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
...You were cooler than anyone out there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm really frustrated after all.
So—let's race again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: With Vodka, Scarlet, and Machan.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, I never thought you'd make a suggestion like that, Chan-san.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah, challenge accepted!
Just try and take down the strongest Umamusume, the great Vodka-sama!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Chan-Mei is the "lead role,"
nothing has changed there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: See ya later~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A thunderous round of applause enveloped Aston Machan as she headed toward the tunnel.
As if drawn by it, she looked up at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Chan, that was so close!
But you were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd get to see a Big Three showdown again!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Pleasant sounds, lovely scenery.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Any place where I stand alongside those two
always becomes so vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is blessed with friends...
and with rivals."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Vodka, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Until next time, somewhere out there. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let us fight, together.
